Commentary.Commentary: Back after Lunch break! Muhammad Hurraira and Shan Masood to open for Pakistan.
...SECOND INNINGS...

The wicket taken by Kashif Ali was the first wicket taken by a Pakistani seamer after 60 consecutive wickets picked by spinners in Pakistan. Close to four tests if we can remember. The debutant Ali got the wicket of Mikyle Louis and it started the domino effect. Shan Masood quickly turned to his spinners and they as usual meant business. Noman Ali became the first Pakistani spinner to take a hat trick in Test cricket. He ended up taking a five fer and making things more worse for West Indies. However, the tail played brilliantly to end a bit on high and balanced out the session. Pakistan are still ahead but they have to bat cleverly on a turning pitch. Stay tuned.

LUNCH! So, what was turning out to be a magical session for Pakistan ended up being a frustrating one! They had to toil hard for the last three wickets which added 109 runs to the total. West Indies were supposed to get rattled over below 100 as the script said but Gudakesh Motie, Kemar Roach and Jomel Warrican had other ideas. They batted and batted to get the team total above 150 and frustrate the home team. However, it was a dismaying performance from their top order who got spun into the web of Noman and Sajid.

OUT! BOWLED'EM! Relieve for Pakistan! Bowls it well outside off and it turns in sharply. Motie swings wildly and misses and it goes through the gate and crashes the stumps. West Indies are bowled out for 163.

The second match is held in Multan and probably on the same pitch so expect yet another feisty contest against the spinners. Dominate on the home is what Pakistan are eying to and recent results have put Pakistan on the right track. Expect yet again them to put the tourist dance on the music. West Indies will try and strengthen their batting a bit and maybe bring in an extra spinner in place of a seamer as we expect Pakistan yo use a turning pitch yet again. Can West Indies level the series or the hosts will cleansweep? Toss and team sheets next.

Hello and welcome to the second and final Test match between Pakistan and West Indies. The hosts run riot on an absolute turning track against an inexperienced Windies squad who got trapped in the web within just three days on a heavy turning Multan pitch. West Indies had no clue against Sajid-Noman duo and Abrar Ahmed to some extent as the Pakistani spinners bowled brilliantly to bundle out the visitors and win the first match comfortably.
